brief: 请用 100—170 个非空白字符向虚构采购组说明“试用期零停机”的证据来自谁、是否经过独立验证、可否推断长期可靠性。仅使用 S1 和 S2，明确归属并引用来源。

sources.text: 虚构供应商简报：供应商自报其设备在12个试用站点运行六个月，期间没有停机。简报没有提供统一故障定义或原始运行日志。
虚构独立评估说明：本次仅检查设备设计文档，未取得站点运行日志，未验证停机次数或长期可靠性。该说明不支持或反驳供应商报告的具体停机数。

rubric.scope: One-judge prospective pilot; does not replace historical panels or current Full report acceptance.

anchors.1: Major defects make this aspect unusable
anchors.3: Meets the task with bounded issues
anchors.not_assessed: Insufficient assessment context; not zero or approval

rubric.instructions: Judge first submissions against the same brief and full supplied sources. Do not award points for files, logs, checklist markers or report length. Rate each dimension separately with a reason, an exact locatable excerpt and source evidence. Do not compute a weighted passing score. Prefer the report that better supports the requested decision; use tie for comparable quality and unresolved for missing evidence. Give condition clues only after choosing. Model preferences and ratings need evidence review before any efficacy interpretation.

reports.A: 供应商自报12个站点六个月没有停机，这一数字应明确归属于供应商，而不能写成无来源的事实。[S1] 独立评估未验证这一运行结果，只检查了设计文档。[S2] 现有材料缺少统一故障定义和原始日志，短期试用也不足以证明长期可靠性；采购前应取得可核查的日志、统计口径及更长观察资料。
